title: DNS: Remove Key ID/Tag naming ambiguity
description:
Some DNSSEC-related RRs used the field name `Key ID` which can be considered a legacy naming.
Renamed the fields to have a consistent `Key Tag` naming for all RRs. Also aligned decimal representation and variable/function names.

This naming complies to e.g. RFC 4034.
